rules: No Inter or generic sans for headings.
Variable weights: use font-light or font-black to break standard bold/regular binary.
Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase, text-xs, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
95% of UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action.
Never use pure black #000000 or #808080. Tint greys slightly.
High contrast text ONLY. Never gray-on-gray.
Focus states MUST have HIGHER contrast.

layout_and_spacing.generous_spacing_philosophy: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: The Swiss Grid: strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact spacing for data, but massive white space around the form container.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical Alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_radius: Sharp edges or max 4px border-radius. Crisp edges via semi-transparent borders + shadows.

buttons.primary: Large, prominent 'Submit to AI Engine', absolute Pitch Black background (bg-primary), text-primary-foreground, minimal hover effect (-translate-y-1), crisp edges.

inputs.style: Shadcn components, customized with sharp corners, 1px subtle border, large hit areas (h-12 or h-14), clean typography.

checkbox.style: Active checkbox for UAE data privacy consent. Sharp square, high contrast checkmark.

cards_and_surfaces.style: Grid Borders: expose the skeleton. border-collapse style layout for the founders list.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp, fast, subtle lift or border color darken.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page app structure: Onboarding Form + Founders List Page.
Form must include Name, Skills, Learning Goals (Text/Textarea) and UAE data privacy checkbox.
CTA must be large and prominent.
Integrate a mock or actual Claude AI call when submitted to generate a personalized welcome/learning roadmap.
The Founder List should display submissions with AI insights in a brutalist, clean grid or table format.
Use data-testid on every interactive element.
